name: apply.coop
description: A free, bilingual (English/Spanish) directory of values-driven workplaces for job seekers, built by Limeleaf Worker Collective, a worker co-op. It began in 2025 as a job board for co-ops only and has since become a directory of employers, each with a profile linking to its own site. When checked it listed 70 cooperatives (worker co-ops such as Equal Exchange, Igalia, Gimme! Coffee, and GEO, plus credit unions and electric co-ops), along with 31 nonprofits and 6 public benefit corporations, so it is not limited to co-ops. Anyone can suggest a workplace to add. It says it doesn't track users or keep personal data, and it is free for job seekers.

research.notes: A web tool, not a community: the only channels are a feedback form and a Mastodon account (@applycoop@social.coop), which is one-way. The 2025 beta announcement and the Open Collective page describe a paid job board for verified co-ops only. The live site no longer shows job postings, only workplace profiles, and also lists nonprofits and public benefit corporations; the record describes the live site. geoScope is US because nearly all the listed workplaces are in the US, though a few (CERN, DATEV, Igalia) are in Europe.
